classOnly: This project is open to workshop participants only for now. Log in to see it.
charterAccept: I have read and accept the charter
addPointHint: Tap the map to place it.
videoLink: YouTube or Vimeo link (no video files)
headphones: Use headphones: the live mic will feed back through speakers.
f_credit: Credit / source (if not your own capture: archive, photographer…)
placeMetaEmpty: No description of this place yet.
movePlaceHint: Tap the map at the place's new position.
confirmDeletePlace: Delete “{name}” and everything in it ({n} items)? This cannot be undone.
confirmLogout: Do you really want to log out?
fileKept: leave empty to keep the current file
noIR: No impulse response here yet. Add one to listen to the acoustics of this place.
cavernHint: turn the view, the sound follows your gaze
cavernAvailable: This impulse response is linked to a 360° photo: open it for immersive listening.
storageHint: These stay in Firebase, readable only by logged-in accounts: never in the public GitHub repository.
projectPublicHint: Unchecked: only logged-in participants can see the site (during the workshop). Checked: anyone can browse it.
confirmPublic: Make the project visible to everyone?
uploadNotConfigured: File storage is not set up yet (Settings, admins only).
imageDecode: This browser cannot read the image (HEIC?). Export it as JPEG or upload it from the phone.
lim_imageType: Only JPEG and PNG files are accepted.
lim_soundType: Only MP3, WAV and AIFF files are accepted.
lim_soundUnreadable: This sound file could not be read.
lim_aiff: AIFF files are converted to WAV (lossless) so they play everywhere.
fix_trimConvert: Keep the first 5 minutes and convert
lim_allFull: This place has reached all its limits (images, sounds, texts). An admin can raise them in “Edit place”.
lim_hintSound: MP3, WAV or AIFF, 5 min and {max} MB maximum.
videoLinkInvalid: Paste a valid YouTube or Vimeo link.
lim_adminTooBig: Even for admins, the maximum is {max} per file.
lim_adminHint: Admin: you can upload heavier or longer files, up to {max} MB.
networkError: Connection dropped during upload (3 attempts). Check the network and try again.
cleanupHint: A file deleted on the site stays on Cloudinary until the cleanup: automatic every night (around 3 am), or right away with the button below. Only files older than 1 h that are no longer used are erased.
cleanupLast: Last cleanup: {date} — {deleted} file(s) erased, {mb} MB freed · {used} in use / {stored} stored.
githubTokenHint: Fine-grained GitHub token limited to the {repo} repository, permission “Actions: read and write”. Shared by all projects, readable by admins only.
githubTokenMissing: Add a GitHub token first (field above).
confirmClean: Permanently erase from Cloudinary every file the site no longer uses?
cleanSlow: The cleanup is taking longer than expected: see the Actions tab of the GitHub repository.
cleanFailed: The cleanup could not be started
f_irRotation: Mic orientation relative to the 360° photo (°)
rotationHint: Leave 0 if you are not sure.
f_creditText: Author / source (if it is a quotation)
proc_intro: Processing applied to the file before upload (24-bit WAV, all channels kept).
proc_align: Align: remove the pre-delay (keep 2 ms before the attack)
proc_trim: Cut the tail where the decay meets the noise, with a fade
proc_deconv: Deconvolution (if the file is a recorded sweep)
proc_none: None — the file is already an impulse response
proc_metis: METIS sweep (100 Hz – 8 kHz, 1.5 s, provided sample)
proc_refFile: The sweep file as it was played
noPanoYet: No 360° photo in this place yet: add one in Gallery, then link it here (Edit) or from the photo.
noIRYet: No impulse response in this place yet: add one in Acoustics, then link it here (Edit) or from the IR.
fmtDetectedN: {n} channels detected: only the first will be used.
fmtChanged4: Format set to AmbiX — choose FuMa if your mic records in that order.
fmtChanged2: Format set to stereo — choose binaural for a dummy head.
panoDetectedXmp: This image is tagged as a 360° (equirectangular) photo in its metadata.
panoDetectedRatio: This image is {w}×{h} (2:1): it is probably a 360° photo.
panoNotTwoToOne: This image is {w}×{h}, not 2:1: an equirectangular 360° image is twice as wide as it is tall. It may look distorted.
proc_trimDb: Cut sensitivity: margin above the noise
proc_trimDbHint: 0 dB = keep the tail down to the noise · 20 dB = cut early (shorter tail).
proc_cutAt: cut at +{db} dB above the noise
noProject: This account is not attached to any project.
projectUnavailable: Your project cannot be found or opened. Contact the admins.
noPublicProjects: No public project yet. Log in to open yours.
noProjectsAdmin: No project yet. Create one with “New project” in the menu at the top.
np_importHint: Fills the form from another project's export or a template. Keys may be included; they are never exported.
np_idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3–40 characters. E.g. esaaa-2026.
np_public: Public project (shown on the world map)
np_cloudHint: Each project uses its own free Cloudinary account: cloud name and unsigned upload preset (Settings → Upload → Upload presets).
np_keysHint: Needed to clean up deleted files automatically. Encrypted in your browser; nobody can read them back afterwards.
np_testNeeds: Fill in at least the cloud name and the preset.
np_keysSkipped: API keys not given: no automatic cleanup
np_testFailed: The upload test failed: check the cloud name and the preset (Unsigned mode).
np_keysFailed: The API keys are refused: correct them or leave them empty.
acc_partial: {n} account(s) created, then stopped: {err}. You can complete them from Settings → Accounts.
acc_hint: This project's accounts. A copy of the passwords is kept here (readable by admins only).
acc_confirmDelete: Delete the account {u}? Their content stays on the map.
adm_keysKeep: leave empty to keep the current keys
base_viewHint: Frame the map the way it should open, then save.
base_levelsHint: Each level can have a plan (PNG/JPEG image or PDF) that you then place on the map.
base_lines: Line drawing (light lines on the dark map)
base_confirmDelLevel: Delete the level “{name}”? Its places remain but will no longer be shown.
base_pdfPage: This PDF has {n} pages: which one?
base_pdfRendering: Converting the PDF to an image…
base_samplesHint: Dry sounds offered in Acoustics, in addition to the site's shared samples.
base_charterHint: Text each participant accepts at first login. Empty = the site's default charter.
alignHint: Drag the centre point, then adjust rotation, width and opacity. Satellite base to line up with the roofs.
arc_isActive: The project is active: participants can contribute.
arc_isArchived: The project is archived: read-only for everyone (except admins).
arc_hint: Archiving blocks additions and edits; files stay on the project’s Cloudinary.
arc_confirmArchive: Archive this project? Nobody (except admins) will be able to add or edit content.
arc_staticHint: A self-contained ZIP of the project (read-only site + data + files). Unzip it and open it with a web server, or publish it anywhere: it no longer depends on Firebase or Cloudinary.
